steps.text: Morning ❤️
I reached for my bag and remembered where it was
It's still beside the sofa
At least one of us got to stay at your place last night
Your bag was very quiet company
Then don't get too attached to it 😌
Too late. We've already had breakfast
Without me? Rude
Here's the person you should have invited instead
She has a permanent invitation
Good. Keep that in mind 🤍
How's your leg after yesterday?
A bit stiff when I got up, but better after moving around a little
I'm glad we stopped when we did
Me too. I'll take it easy this morning
What are you planning?
A few things around the house this morning, then probably some games later
What about you?
I'm spending the afternoon with my family
Lunch first. Then apparently we're playing cards
Apparently?
I was informed. My participation wasn't optional 😭
Try to come back with your dignity intact
I'll aim higher. I'm going to win
That's the spirit
And then I'll graciously allow them to admire me
Very gracious
Exactly
Okay, I need to get ready
Keep my bag safe. I'll collect it when I see you
Of course. Have a good time today ❤️
You too love
